industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Electric Power Development Co.,Ltd.
summary: Electric Power Development Co., Ltd. (J-POWER) is an energy company that mostly sells electricity from hydroelectric and thermal plants wholesale in Japan. Besides generation and transmission, it makes fuels from wood, carbonized sewage sludge and other biomass, and manages a coal chain from investment and imports through shipping to sales. By-products add to its revenue.
